meta.title: Heatscape NYC

interventions.label: Plant street trees
interventions.desc: Heavy footfall on hot streets with little canopy — expand tree pits and street canopy along the busiest blocks.

interventions.label: Cool roofs
interventions.desc: Dense, dark built volume driving the heat island — reflective coating retrofits cut absorbed radiation.

interventions.label: Outdoor cooling amenities
interventions.desc: Hot, busy streets far from a spray shower, with children present — add hydration and misting points.

interventions.label: Indoor cooling support
interventions.desc: Low AC access far from a cooling centre, with older residents — subsidise AC, open cooling centres nearby.

interventions.label: Shaded pedestrian corridors
interventions.desc: Heavy foot traffic past dense services on exposed streets — continuous shade structures along key routes.

interventions.label: New open & green space
interventions.desc: Hot, socially exposed cells with little open space — convert lots to pocket parks and community green space.

ntaNames: Jacob Riis Park-Fort Tilden-Breezy Point Tip

removed.pop_den: node removed from the systems diagram; residents still enter scoring through the population gate

indicatorSource.note: Indicator set reconciled with the nyc-greenery systems diagram (52 nodes, 95 edges). Population density was dropped with its diagram node; its share of the street-tree and green-space intervention factors was redistributed pro rata.

interventionSource.rule: `factors` names the levers an intervention acts on and records each lever's default Shapley value. The app always scores with the live value from that lever's slider, renormalised over the intervention's own lever list, so re-weighting an indicator moves the intervention ranking with the priority map. A cat: factor carries its category's summed share and is scored on that category's mean. Levers with zero attribution carry no weight and were removed from the lists.

removedInterventions.porous_paving: Permeable paving removed: its levers were impervious ground and canopy cover, neither of which is an indicator carrying attribution, so the intervention could only be scored on proxies already used by cool roofs and new green space.

interventionSource.factorScale: Factors are raw shapley_share values, not renormalised to 1 -- at the default weights they are exactly what the app scores with, and their ratios are the intervention's internal weighting.
